summary: Iteration 8 verification of 4 user-reported fixes. ALL acceptance criteria PASS. (1) Exhibitions 16 domestic city cards render immediately on initial page load with NO tab click required — confirmed 16 [data-testid^=city-card-*] in DOM on first paint; 11 cards contain (remaining 5 use the rl-city-fallback because their seeded image URLs fail/404 — cosmetic/data issue, unrelated to this iteration's fix). (2) International tab still shows exactly 4 city cards. (3) index.html preconnect hints present for rudralife.com, images.unsplash.com, customer-assets.emergentagent.com; preload as=image with fetchpriority=high for hero banner — all confirmed. (4) India map pin inline style now left:68.5%/top:40%; visual inspection at 1920x1000 confirms pin sits on mainland Indian subcontinent (NOT on Sri Lanka / NOT in Arabian Sea). Global Presence subtitle updated: no longer contains 'Tap any pin to discover', now reads 'Five countries. One unbroken tradition. Hosted in five-star venues and private sanctums worldwide.' (5) Footer has 4 social icons — social-instagram, social-facebook, social-youtube, social-linkedin — LinkedIn href exactly 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/rudralife', all target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer. (6) Mobile hero at 390x844: .rl-hero-bg is position:absolute with inset 0/0/0/0, fills the wrap (390x844), .rl-hero-wrap has transparent background (no 'brown panel' below), text overlay visible at bottom with bottom vignette — confirmed visually. (7) Tablet portrait 820x1180 and landscape 1180x820: banner full-bleed, mala visible, text overlaid, no separate brown section. (8) Backend regression: /api/register and /api/registrations still green (6/6 pytest tests pass).

issues: 5 of 16 domestic cards fell back to the letter placeholder on first load because their seeded image URLs (in /app/frontend/src/data/exhibitions.js) fail to resolve / return non-image. Not a regression from this iteration — the lazy-img refactor works exactly as designed; just the underlying image URLs are broken. Recommend auditing exhibitions.js image URLs.

Malaysia (77%/49.5%) and Singapore (77.8%/51.5%) pin labels are in close proximity; at narrower viewports the Malaysia label can be visually eclipsed by Singapore label. Cosmetic only (flagged in iter 7 as well).
